articles.title: Battle for Michigan: Two Democrats, One Big Fight
articles.summary: Michigan voters are picking between two very different Democrats for Senate. Abdul El-Sayed, backed by Bernie Sanders, faces Haley Stevens, supported by party leaders. The winner takes on Republican Mike Rogers in a key race that could decide who controls the Senate.

articles.title: Is Your 'Healthy' Snack Tricking You? The Truth About Avocado Oil
articles.summary: A new study found that 89% of avocado-oil products tested might be mixed with cheaper oils. Even if a label says '100% avocado oil,' it could be fake. Companies use buzzwords like 'organic' to make us think food is healthier — and charge more. Here's how to spot the tricks.

articles.title: Too Hot for Lions: Tokyo Zoo Loses Three Lionesses in Record Heatwave
articles.summary: Three lionesses at a Tokyo zoo have died from suspected heatstroke as East Asia bakes under record heat. South Korea declared a national disaster after 19 people died. Scientists say climate change is making heatwaves longer and stronger. Even animals built for heat are struggling.
